stoich_afr.name: Scalar - Stoich AFR (literal pool)
stoich_afr.description: Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio (14.7 = gasoline); converts lambda to AFR in the fuel-correction/AFR display. For a different-stoich fuel set this to the new stoich (e.g. 9.76 for E85) and scale 'Scalar - Fuel Load Scale' by 14.7/new stoich. Stock ROMs have no ethanol-indexed stoich table - this fixed scalar is the only stoich constant.
stoich_afr.evidence: 14.7 stoichiometric AFR literal @0x3e7ec, referenced by mova @0x3e6ec in FUN_0003e560; used as diag_afr_word_a * fVar4 * 14.7 in the fuel-correction/catalyst model (feeds fuel_correction_sum_ffffc644, PID 0x3c). Exactly one occurrence per ROM (verified all 11). This is the single-value 'base AFR' scalar (VersaTuner 'Air Fuel Ratio Base'); per-operating-point AFR lives in maps tbl_06ac88/tbl_069e9c.

fuel_load_scale.name: Scalar - Fuel Load Scale (literal pool)
fuel_load_scale.description: Scales engine load into the base injected fuel volume; editing changes open-loop fueling. For a different-stoich fuel scale it by 14.7/new stoich (E85: x1.506), paired with setting 'Scalar - Stoich AFR' to the new stoich.
fuel_load_scale.evidence: engine_load * 0.07196 in ref_calcFuelVolumeRequest (0x306e8) via literal pointer 0x30830 -> pool 0x78170; multiplied into final fuel volume beb0 = beac * bed0. Verified in reviews/load_fueling_model/validation.json rom_literal_checks.

load_cell_scale.name: Scalar - Load Cell Scale (literal pool)
load_cell_scale.description: Converts air per revolution (g/rev) into the engine-load cell units used by the fuel and ignition maps (1/(engine displacement x air density)).
load_cell_scale.evidence: air_per_rev * 0.6345 in ref_airPerStroke via literal pointer 0x33b70 -> pool 0x7a088; 0.6345 = 1/(1.308 L * 1.205 g/L) VolEf cell units (ROADMAP D5). Verified in validation.json.

air_per_rev_factor.name: Scalar - Air Per Rev Factor (literal pool)
air_per_rev_factor.description: Seconds-per-minute factor in the air-per-revolution calculation (air flow in g/s to g/rev).
air_per_rev_factor.evidence: air_per_rev = min(maf * 60.0 / rpm, 5.0) at 0x1a418; 60.0 literal @0x1a4e8 (s/rev conversion). Verified in validation.json.

air_per_rev_clamp.name: Scalar - Air Per Rev Clamp (literal pool)
air_per_rev_clamp.description: Upper clamp of the computed air per revolution (g/rev).
air_per_rev_clamp.evidence: min(..., 5.0) clamp of air_per_rev at 0x1a418; 5.0 literal @0x1a4f4. Verified in validation.json.
